messages:
nina_infra: Quick sync — we need to lock infra for the EU payments pilot (Acme). Product OKR expects beta in ~6w. Can procurement/ops propose committed vs spot mix + SKU choice by EOD tomorrow?

sam_product: Clarify numbers: expected peak ~500 rps, ~10M tokens/day. SLO: 99p latency <=150ms. Those drive determinism — leaning toward more committed.

lee_sre: Noted. Quick gut: pure spot = risky for 99p. Proposal: 12 committed nodes in eu-west1 + 6 spot for burst; 2 dedicated canary across a different AZ. Autoscale policy: warm-spare 2 nodes, cooldown 5m.

maya_finance: Cost sanity check: 12 committed vs 20 committed swings monthly run-rate a lot. Need a justification for commit size tied to Acme contract (revenue runway). I'll run numbers if you give SKU and hours.

devon_hw: SKU guidance depends on model and quantization. For short-context generation (mostly 2–4k tokens), mid-tier inference cards (A10G/RTX6000-class or A800 equivalent) give best $/latency when quantized. A100/A800 80GB is overkill unless we need large context or multi-model packing. I can run perf tests on 4090/A10G replica images.

sam_product: Acme contract wants 'predictable latency under load' wording. If committed reduces cost by X% vs overprovisioning, sales will sign. But we need a fallback policy in case EU capacity degrades.

nina_infra: Draft proposal then: 12 committed (eu-west1) — g4-like sku (devon to confirm exact model), 6 spot for batch/embeddings, 2 dedicated canary in eu-west2. Fallback policy: route to us-west1 with model-variant (quantized) if latency SLO breached for >3min or spot reclaim spike >4% in 1h.

lee_sre: Add technical controls: prefix/KV cache warmup on canary, continuous batching disabled for canary route, healthchecks at token-level. Alerting: composite alert when P99 latency increases >20% or token errors >0.5%. Also record spot reclaim SIGs to metric 'spot_reclaim_rate'.

maya_finance: If devon confirms A10G perf, I'll model 12 committed vs 16 committed scenarios and put into the deal desk. Which tag for PO?

procurement-bot: PO draft created: PO-4521 (12 committed nodes, eu-west1, provisional SKU pending). Status: awaiting finance + legal.

nina_infra: Action items: 1) devon_hw: perf matrix for A10G vs 4090 by Wed COB, 2) lee_sre: write fallback policy & alert thresholds as PR to infra-runbook by Thu, 3) maya_finance: cost scenarios for 12 vs 16 committed by Thu. I'll update infra OKR doc and loop in sales. Thanks. :thumbsup:

sam_product: Sounds good. If we can show expected p99 under target with 12 committed + 6 spot, product can take that to Acme as the infra plan.

lee_sre: One more note — recommend we reserve 1–2 additional IPs and capacity for debugging sessions during launch (don’t want debug jobs to evict production).

nina_infra: Good call. I'll include reserved debug pool in the PO draft. Follow-ups on the PRs in #infra-docs.

(automated) deploy-bot: New PR created: infra/fallback-policy-1967890123 by lee_sre — CI checks running.
